assets.generationPrompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: Matkakirja photorealistic wide game catalogue image, landscape 16:9, intended final 1600 by 900.
Primary request: Generate one entirely NEW complete photograph-like image from scratch using the supplied square mini solely as a visual reference for the SAME wooden Nine Men's Morris board and round wooden stock pieces, high slightly oblique camera angle, natural light, muted warm beige colors and composition. Redraw everything anew in a wider tabletop scene. Do not crop or paste source pixels.
Scene/backdrop: Same soft neutral warm beige textured tabletop, softly lit from upper left, natural restrained wood colors, expanded gently blurred quiet tabletop to both sides.
Subject: The SAME complete square honey brown wooden board with rounded corners, visible thickness and natural wood grain, centered and wholly inside frame with generous margins. Same camera angle as the reference: looking down from high above and slightly from the front, board seen as a gentle perspective trapezoid, rear edge narrower than front. The board and pieces together fit within 82 percent of image height.
Board diagram must be exact and simple: THREE nested SQUARES, concentric, each made of four straight thin dark engraved sides. Each square has EIGHT small dark circular points: its four corners and the exact midpoint of each of its four sides, totaling exactly TWENTY-FOUR board points. FOUR straight midpoint connectors only: one at top side midpoint, one at right side midpoint, one at bottom side midpoint, one at left side midpoint, joining the outer square through the middle square to the inner square. The midpoint connectors STOP at the inner square; the center of the inner square is completely blank. No connections from corners. No diagonals. No lines crossing the center. Exactly three squares, not diamonds or extra rings.
In the tabletop foreground below the board, exactly SIX loose smooth stock pieces in a neat row as in the mini: THREE pale natural wood discs on the left, THREE dark walnut discs on the right. All six are off the board. Board itself has no playing pieces, so all 24 dark board points remain visible.
Style/medium: Photorealistic tabletop product photography, authentic wood, fine engraved black lines, soft natural light and gentle shadows, sharp legible game geometry, no HDR, no painting, no illustration, no cartoon.
Constraints: Whole board including all four corners fully visible, plus all six foreground discs fully visible. No people, hands, faces, text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, watermarks, national marks, frames, additional objects, diagonal connectors or center cross.
